ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20 ratio of high-intensity pixels (white/light-gray) to low-intensity pixels (black/near-black) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black field across both lobes. Numerous discrete, high-contrast annular white clusters (rings) distributed across the surface. Concentrated high-intensity, irregular white and tan pixel masses at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary. A significant macro-scale negative deviation (deep notch) is present on the outer third of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep from the center. The trailing edges follow a generally linear trajectory from the median notch to the tips, interrupted by micro-serrations and one major macro-anomaly.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular/annular white pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed across the black field, with specific high-density mapping on the upper-mid region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, faint horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible primarily on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic indentation (missing tissue segment) on the trailing edge of the left lobe. Heavy irregular scarring and mineralization-like pixel patterns on both distal lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The large, semi-circular indentation on the left trailing edge serves as a primary unique structural identifier.
